name: What defines a luxury condo, and how does it differ from a standard condo?

mainEntity.name: What defines a luxury condo, and how does it differ from a standard condo?

acceptedAnswer.text: A luxury condo typically features premium finishes, high-end appliances, sophisticated smart home technology, and exclusive amenities like private concierges, spas, and rooftop lounges. Unlike standard condos, luxury units often offer larger floor plans, superior construction quality, and prime locations with desirable views. When considering a purchase, evaluate how these upgraded features align with your lifestyle expectations and long-term investment goals. Your agent can help identify specific properties in areas like Miami Beach or Aventura that meet these criteria.
acceptedAnswer.description: Luxury condos offer premium finishes, high-end appliances, smart home technology, and exclusive amenities, distinguishing them from standard units.
